tests.title: SSC CGL Quantitative Aptitude Tier-1 Mock Test 1

questions.questionText: If $x + \frac{1}{x} = 4$, then find the value of $x^3 + \frac{1}{x^3}$.
The ratio of two numbers is 3 : 5. If 9 is subtracted from each, the new ratio becomes 12 : 23. Find the smaller number.
questions.explanation: Let numbers be $3x$ and $5x$. $\frac{3x - 9}{5x - 9} = \frac{12}{23} \implies 23(3x-9) = 12(5x-9) \implies 69x - 207 = 60x - 108 \implies 9x = 99 \implies x = 11$. Smaller number = $3(11) = 33$.

questions.questionText: A shopkeeper marks an article 25% above its cost price and allows a discount of 10% on the marked price. Find his profit percentage.
A can do a piece of work in 12 days and B in 18 days. They work together for 4 days, then A leaves. In how many days will B finish the remaining work?
questions.explanation: Total work = LCM(12, 18) = 36 units. A's efficiency = 3 units/day, B's efficiency = 2 units/day. Combined efficiency = 5 units/day. Work done in 4 days = $4 \times 5 = 20$ units. Remaining work = $36 - 20 = 16$ units. Time taken by B = $16 / 2 = 8$ days.

questions.questionText: A train running at a speed of 72 km/h crosses a pole in 15 seconds. What is the length of the train?
questions.explanation: Speed in m/s = $72 \times \frac{5}{18} = 20$ m/s. Length of train = Speed × Time = $20 \times 15 = 300$ meters.

questions.questionText: Find the value of $\frac{\sin 30^{\circ} + \cos 60^{\circ}}{\tan 45^{\circ}}$.
In $\triangle ABC$, the bisector of $\angle A$ meets $BC$ at $D$. If $AB = 6\text{ cm}$, $AC = 8\text{ cm}$, and $BD = 3\text{ cm}$, find the length of $DC$.
questions.explanation: By Angle Bisector Theorem: $\frac{AB}{AC} = \frac{BD}{DC} \implies \frac{6}{8} = \frac{3}{DC} \implies DC = \frac{8 \times 3}{6} = 4\text{ cm}$.

questions.questionText: A sum of ₹10,000 is invested at 10% per annum compound interest, compounded annually. Find the compound interest for 2 years.
What is the remainder when $7^{84}$ is divided by 342?
A student has to score 33% marks to pass an exam. He gets 125 marks and fails by 40 marks. Find the maximum marks.
The average weight of a class of 30 students is 45 kg. If the weight of the teacher is included, the average weight increases by 1 kg. Find the weight of the teacher.
questions.explanation: Total weight of 30 students = $30 \times 45 = 1350$ kg. Total weight of 31 people = $31 \times 46 = 1426$ kg. Weight of teacher = $1426 - 1350 = 76$ kg.

questions.questionText: If the radius of a sphere is doubled, by what percentage does its volume increase?
questions.explanation: Initial volume $V_1 = \frac{4}{3}\pi r^3$. New volume $V_2 = \frac{4}{3}\pi (2r)^3 = 8 V_1$. Increase = $7 V_1$. Percentage increase = $\frac{7 V_1}{V_1} \times 100 = 700\%$.

questions.questionText: If $\alpha$ and $\beta$ are the roots of the equation $x^2 - 7x + 12 = 0$, find the value of $\alpha^2 + \beta^2$.
Walking at $\frac{3}{4}$ of his usual speed, a man reaches his office 20 minutes late. Find his usual time to reach the office.
questions.explanation: Speed ratio = $3 : 4$, Time ratio = $4 : 3$. Difference = $1$ unit = $20$ minutes. Usual time ($3$ units) = $3 \times 20 = 60$ minutes.

questions.questionText: The length of the common chord of two intersecting circles is 24 cm. If the diameters of the circles are 30 cm and 26 cm, find the distance between their centers.
questions.explanation: Radii are $R_1 = 15$ cm, $R_2 = 13$ cm. Half chord $h = 12$ cm. Distance to center 1 = $\sqrt{15^2 - 12^2} = 9$ cm. Distance to center 2 = $\sqrt{13^2 - 12^2} = 5$ cm. Total distance = $9 + 5 = 14$ cm.

questions.questionText: If $\tan \theta + \cot \theta = 2$, find the value of $\tan^2 \theta + \cot^2 \theta$.
A sum of ₹8,000 becomes ₹9,200 in 3 years at simple interest. What will it become in 3 years if the rate of interest is increased by 3%?
Find the HCF of 0.54, 1.8, and 7.2.
In a right-angled triangle $ABC$, right-angled at $B$, if $AB = 5\text{ cm}$ and $BC = 12\text{ cm}$, find the length of the altitude drawn from $B$ to hypotenuse $AC$.
questions.explanation: Hypotenuse $AC = \sqrt{5^2 + 12^2} = 13$ cm. Area = $\frac{1}{2} \times 5 \times 12 = 30$. Also Area = $\frac{1}{2} \times AC \times h = \frac{1}{2} \times 13 \times h = 30 \implies h = \frac{60}{13} \approx 4.61$ cm.

questions.questionText: A milkman has 20 liters of a mixture of milk and water containing 10% water. How much water should be added to make it 25% water?
questions.explanation: Initial water = $10\%$ of $20 = 2$ liters. Initial milk = $18$ liters. Let $x$ liters of water be added. $\frac{2 + x}{20 + x} = \frac{25}{100} = \frac{1}{4} \implies 4(2 + x) = 20 + x \implies 8 + 4x = 20 + x \implies 3x = 12 \implies x = 4$ liters.

tests.title: SSC CGL Quantitative Aptitude Tier-1 Mock Test 2

questions.questionText: If $x - \frac{1}{x} = 5$, then find the value of $x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2}$.
In a 60-liter mixture, the ratio of milk and water is 2 : 1. How much water should be added so that the ratio becomes 1 : 2?
questions.explanation: Milk = 40 L, Water = 20 L. Let water added = $w$. $\frac{40}{20 + w} = \frac{1}{2} \implies 80 = 20 + w \implies w = 60$ liters.

questions.questionText: By selling an article for ₹720, a loss of 10% is incurred. At what price should it be sold to earn a 20% profit?
questions.explanation: Cost Price = $\frac{720}{0.9} = ₹800$. Selling Price for 20% profit = $800 \times 1.2 = ₹960$.

questions.questionText: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 15 hours and 20 hours, while C can empty it in 30 hours. If all three are opened together, in how many hours will the tank be full?
questions.explanation: Total capacity = 60 units. A's rate = 4, B's = 3, C's = -2. Net rate = $4 + 3 - 2 = 5$ units/hour. Time = $60 / 5 = 12$ hours.

questions.questionText: A car covers 300 km in 5 hours, partly at 50 km/h and partly at 70 km/h. Find the distance covered at 70 km/h.
questions.explanation: Let time at 70 km/h be $t$. $50(5-t) + 70t = 300 \implies 250 + 20t = 300 \implies 20t = 50 \implies t = 2.5$ hours. Distance = $70 \times 2.5 = 175$ km.

questions.questionText: Evaluate: $\sin^2 30^{\circ} + \cos^2 60^{\circ} + \tan^2 45^{\circ}$.
The areas of two similar triangles $\triangle ABC$ and $\triangle PQR$ are $64\text{ cm}^2$ and $121\text{ cm}^2$. If $QR = 11\text{ cm}$, find $BC$.
Find the compound interest on ₹8,000 at 15% per annum for 2 years, compounded annually.
Find the unit digit of $(2137)^{753}$.
questions.explanation: Cyclicity of 7 is 4. $753 \pmod 4 = 1$. So unit digit is $7^1 = 7$.

questions.questionText: If the price of sugar is increased by 20%, by what percentage should a family reduce consumption to keep expenditure unchanged?
The mean of 10 numbers is 15. If one number 21 is excluded, what is the new mean?
questions.explanation: Initial sum = $10 \times 15 = 150$. New sum = $150 - 21 = 129$. New mean = $129 / 9 = 14.33$.

questions.questionText: The total surface area of a solid hemisphere of radius 7 cm is: (Take $\pi = 22/7$)
If $a + b + c = 9$ and $ab + bc + ca = 26$, find $a^2 + b^2 + c^2$.
Two trains of length 140 m and 160 m are running in opposite directions at 60 km/h and 48 km/h. In how much time will they cross each other?
questions.explanation: Total distance = $140 + 160 = 300$ m. Relative speed = $60 + 48 = 108$ km/h = $108 \times \frac{5}{18} = 30$ m/s. Time = $300 / 30 = 10$ seconds.

questions.questionText: A tangent $PQ$ at a point $P$ of a circle of radius 5 cm meets a line through the center $O$ at a point $Q$ so that $OQ = 12\text{ cm}$. Find the length of $PQ$.
Find the value of $x$ if $2^{x+3} = 32$.
A sum of money doubles itself at simple interest in 8 years. What is the rate of interest per annum?
Find the median of the data: 12, 17, 11, 19, 15, 13, 20.
questions.explanation: In ascending order: 11, 12, 13, 15, 17, 19, 20. The 4th (middle) number is 15.

questions.questionText: Find the area of a triangle with sides 13 cm, 14 cm, and 15 cm.
A bag contains 5 red balls and 7 white balls. A ball is drawn at random. What is the probability that the ball drawn is white?

tests.title: SSC CGL Quantitative Aptitude Tier-1 Mock Test 3

questions.questionText: If $x^4 + \frac{1}{x^4} = 119$, find the value of $x + \frac{1}{x}$.
Three numbers are in the ratio $2 : 3 : 4$ and the sum of their cubes is 33,957. Find the largest number.
A trader sells two items for ₹4,000 each, gaining 20% on one and losing 20% on the other. What is his net profit or loss percentage?
questions.explanation: Always a loss when selling prices are equal and gain% = loss%. Loss% = $\frac{20^2}{100} = 4\%$ loss.

questions.questionText: A and B can complete a work in 10 days and 15 days respectively. They started together, but A left 2 days before completion. In how many days was the total work completed?
questions.explanation: Total work = 30 units. A = 3 units/day, B = 2 units/day. In last 2 days B worked alone = 4 units. Remaining 26 units done together = $26 / 5 = 5.2$ days. Total time = $5.2 + 2 = 7.2$ days.

questions.questionText: Walking at 60 km/h, a person covers a distance in 4 hours. How much speed should he increase to cover the same distance in 3 hours?
questions.explanation: Distance = $60 \times 4 = 240$ km. Required speed = $240 / 3 = 80$ km/h. Speed increase = $80 - 60 = 20$ km/h.

questions.questionText: If $\sec \theta + \tan \theta = 3$, find the value of $\sec \theta - \tan \theta$.
Find the area of an equilateral triangle whose perimeter is 36 cm.
What sum of money will amount to ₹6,600 in 2 years and to ₹7,200 in 3 years at simple interest?
questions.explanation: Simple Interest for 1 year = $7200 - 6600 = ₹600$. Interest for 2 years = ₹1,200. Principal = $6600 - 1200 = ₹5,400$.

questions.questionText: Find the total number of prime factors in $2^{10} \times 3^5 \times 7^3 \times 11^2$.
Due to a 25% reduction in the price of apples, a customer can buy 2 kg more apples for ₹240. What is the original price per kg?
Find the mode of the following numbers: 5, 7, 8, 5, 9, 5, 8, 6, 7, 5.
questions.explanation: Number 5 appears most frequently (4 times), so mode is 5.

questions.questionText: The volume of a cylinder is $1540\text{ cm}^3$ and its height is 10 cm. Find its radius. (Take $\pi = 22/7$)
questions.explanation: $\pi r^2 h = 1540 \implies \frac{22}{7} \times r^2 \times 10 = 1540 \implies r^2 = 49 \implies r = 7\text{ cm}$.

questions.questionText: If $x + y + z = 0$, find the value of $\frac{x^2}{yz} + \frac{y^2}{zx} + \frac{z^2}{xy}$.
A boat goes 12 km downstream in 48 minutes. If the speed of the current is 3 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = $\frac{12}{48/60} = 15$ km/h. Speed in still water = $15 - 3 = 12$ km/h.

questions.questionText: If the diagonals of a rhombus are 16 cm and 12 cm, find its perimeter.
Find the value of $\frac{\tan 65^{\circ}}{\cot 25^{\circ}}$.
Find the compound interest on ₹12,500 for 1.5 years at 8% p.a., compounded half-yearly.
Find the smallest number which when divided by 12, 16, 18, and 24 leaves a remainder 5 in each case.
Find the length of the diagonal of a cube whose volume is $512\text{ cm}^3$.
In how many ways can the letters of the word 'MATH' be arranged?
questions.explanation: 4 distinct letters can be arranged in $4! = 4 \times 3 \times 2 \times 1 = 24$ ways.
